segments.name: Respiratory Health
segments.description: Develops, manufactures, and markets respiratory health products including portable oxygen concentrators, airway clearance devices, and CPAP masks for patients with chronic respiratory conditions.
segments.evidence: We develop, manufacture, and market innovative respiratory health products, including portable oxygen concentrators, or POCs, used to deliver supplemental long-term oxygen therapy to patients suffering from chronic respiratory conditions and the Simeox ® product for airway clearance treatment.

revenueModel.text: Customers purchase or rent respiratory durable medical equipment and disposables through home medical equipment providers, direct-to-consumer channels, and business-to-business partners.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company derives revenues from customers through the development, manufacturing, marketing, sales, and rental of respiratory products.

changes.text: In September 2023, the company acquired Physio-Assist SAS, expanding into the airway clearance market with the Simeox product.
changes.evidence: On September 14, 2023, we completed the acquisition of all of the issued and outstanding capital stock of Physio-Assist SAS, or Physio-Assist, and its wholly-owned subsidiary PhysioAssist GmbH.

changes.text: In January 2025, the company entered a Strategic Collaboration Agreement with Yuwell to distribute stationary oxygen concentrators and CPAP masks in the United States and expand into Asia-Pacific markets.
changes.evidence: On January 25, 2025, we entered into a Strategic Collaboration Agreement, or the Collaboration Agreement, with Jiangsu Yuyue Medical Equipment & Supply Co., Ltd., or Yuwell.
